messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex V, Part A, point 10

10. Additional information: Signed for and on behalf of: … (place and date of issue): (name, function) (signature):

response.text:
EU declaration of conformity, Annex V Part A | requiresSigning | signed for and on behalf of the issuing party | | Signed for and on behalf of:
EU declaration of conformity, Annex V Part A | requiresIssuePlaceAndDate | place and date of issue must be stated | | (place and date of issue):
EU declaration of conformity, Annex V Part A | requiresSignatoryDetails | name and function of the signatory must be stated | | (name, function)
EU declaration of conformity, Annex V Part A | requiresSignature | signature of the signatory must be provided | | (signature):
EU declaration of conformity, Annex V Part A | allowsAdditionalInformation | additional information may be added in point 10 | | 10. Additional information:
